# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/sparsh
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/sparsh

## File: facebookresearch_sparsh/tactile_ssl/trainer/trainer.py

Prompts

```
['create a Trainer instance with custom accelerator, strategy, devices, precision, and checkpoint settings', "fit a Module with train and validation dataloaders using the Trainer's fit method", 'run a single training epoch with gradient accumulation, clipping, and scheduler stepping', 'run a single validation epoch on the module with the validation dataloader', 'save a model checkpoint to the checkpoint directory with optional probe weights only mode']
```

Usage

```
{'create_trainer': 'create a Trainer instance with custom accelerator, strategy, devices, precision, and checkpoint settings', 'fit_module': "fit a Module with train and validation dataloaders using the Trainer's fit method", 'run_train_loop': 'run a single training epoch with gradient accumulation, clipping, and scheduler stepping', 'run_val_loop': 'run a single validation epoch on the module with the validation dataloader', 'save_checkpoint': 'save a model checkpoint to the checkpoint directory with optional probe weights only mode'}
```
